messages.subject: Project Kestrel - draft Series B term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Victor, Aisha,

Please find attached our draft Series B term sheet reflecting the headline terms discussed: pre-money of £60m, £20m of new investment (post-money £80m), £10.00 per share for 2,000,000 Series B Preferred Shares, taking Ravensworth to 25% fully diluted. Binding provisions are limited to exclusivity, costs and confidentiality.

Grateful for any comments. We would like to sign this week so the lawyers can start on the long-form documents.

Kind regards,
Sarah
Sarah Whitfield  |  Partner

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
